newsitem.title: GREECE: BANK/GREECE OFFERS TO INJECT FUNDS VIA QUICK REPO.
newsitem.headline: BANK/GREECE OFFERS TO INJECT FUNDS VIA QUICK REPO.

text.p: Bank of Greece, the country's central bank, offered to inject an unspecified amount of drachmas via a quick repo auction on Friday at 12.90 percent, it said in a statement.
"The Bank of Greece will conduct a fixed rate quick repo auction on Friday," it said. "Payment date is July 18 and maturity date is July 23."
The selling price was set at 80 percent and the repurchase price at 80.1414 percent, it added.
The minimum amount per bid is 500 million drachmas.
"In case of oversubscription bids will be satisfied pro rata with a minimum allotment of 400 million drachmas," it added.
The results of the auction will be announced no later than 1030 GMT. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
